context: M26 o1. Night desk. Manny stayed late. Inez in the lobby with her laundry.

lines.speaker: char.manny_soto
lines.text: Teddy. Prentiss asked me which rooms are empty on four. Tonight. Why tonight?

lines.speaker: char.inez_rivera
lines.text: I took his five hundred. He told me 'Leave by Tuesday. For your own good.'

lines.speaker: char.inez_rivera
lines.text: My kids are at my sister's. I'm staying. I want to see his face.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Buildings burn, old wiring, nobody's fault. I've heard that speech.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Nobody sleeps on four tonight. Manny, keep the service door. Inez, wake the floors at two.
